fields.description: Stable identifier for this option, generated once. The player receives this key instead of a row index, so shuffling the options never changes what an answer means.
fields.label: Option Key

fields.description: Tick the option(s) that are right. This is never sent to a browser — the learner-facing payload is built with it stripped out.
fields.label: Correct

fields.description: Optional — shown after the learner answers, to explain why this option is right or wrong.
fields.label: Feedback
